text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard flux4b v2 to the model catalog tomorrow at 09:30 PT. Need people for: deploy lead, smoke owner, and rollback readiness. who can own? :calendar:

owen: I can take deploy lead if it's just the catalog pin + canary route. free window for me 09:15-10:00 PT.

samira: I can own smoke tests. will run the full prompt set and sanity embeddings. will be on-call until 10:30 PT. :mag:

leo: I can be backup for rollback and logs if things look off. pls ping me before you flip traffic. :handshake:

deploy-bot: reminder: preflight checks required: `catalog.validate(flux4b:v2)` and `infra.health(all-regions)` — run at least 10m before handover.

maya: awesome. owen — before you run the pin, confirm these are ✅:
- canary target config (10% traffic) set
- variant fallback (flux4b:v1) available
- canary small-batch health window (15m)

owen: copy. I'll set canary 10% and wait 15m. plan to run pin at 09:30 and monitor dashboards for 20m.

samira: smoke checklist (short):
1) 20 sample prompts from prod promptset
2) embeddings similarity quick-check
3) latency p50/p95 within expected delta
4) output tokens sanity (no hallucination spikes)

samira: will post results in thread like: `smoke: PASS` or `smoke: FAIL — sample 7 high perplexity`

maya: rollback procedure (quick):
- owen runs `catalog.pin flux4b:v1 --force-migrate` (this triggers variant swap)
- infra auto-fallback will route live traffic back within ~30s
- leo will collect traces + kv cache stats

leo: got it — if smoke shows >15% fail or p95 > 2x baseline, we rollback.

owen: plan: run `catalog.pin flux4b:v2 --canary 10` at 09:30. I will post the DB transaction id after pin. will call out `@samira @leo` when done.

maya: tiny ask for QA visibility: samira, can you add one targeted prompt that triggers the new attention pattern we changed? want to watch regression risk.

samira: yes — added `prompt_id: flux4b-regen-03` to the smoke set.

deploy-bot: canary started by owen at 09:30: tx=tx_7741. canary target=10%.

samira: smoke: PASS — all checks green, p50/p95 within expected, embeddings delta < 0.02. posted logs in /mnt/smoke/flux4b/v2/2368001234

leo: monitoring: traces look good, no cache amplification. holding for full 20m before wide rollout.

maya: thanks team. if all stays green at 09:50 PT, proceed to full pin. otherwise rollback as described.

owen: canary window complete. will promote to full pin now. pinging infra for final shard sync. :rocket:

deploy-bot: full pin complete: flux4b:v2 is now default. tx=tx_7741-promote. Please file any post-rollout regressions as /incidents/ if severity > P2.

samira: quick note — one sample showed slightly different tokenization, filing a small eval regression ticket.

maya: noted. leo, can you collect perf diffs and attach to the ticket? I'll triage with research tomorrow.

leo: on it. grabbing traces and kv metrics now.

maya: great work everyone. closing thread once artifacts linked. :tada:
